Explanation:- kyunki yahan movie ke baare mein first time baat hui hai sentence mein pehle iska koi zikr nahi hai. 'veh ek well-directed film thi'.

questions.question: Brahmaputra is (a)/one of the longest rivers (b)/that originate (c)/in the Himalayas.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'The' before Brahmaputra.
Explanation:- River ke name se pehle 'the' article ka use hoga.

questions.question: It was a surprising (a)/ to receive the gift (b)/ from my brother.(c)/no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Remove 'a'
Explanation:- 'it was surprising' ya 'it was a surprise' ka use karen, kyunki article ka use noun ke liye kiya jaata hai yahan 'surprising' adjective hai.

questions.question: This is (a)/the most important (b)/question which you have (c)/to prepare very carefully.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'a' in place of 'the'.
Explanation:- 'a most important question' = a very important question. Yahan iss question ki tulna kisi aur question se nahi karni hai isliye superlative degree 'the most' ka use nahi hoga.

questions.question: Antique diamond necklace (a)/ was stolen (b)/ from the museum.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'An' before 'antique diamond necklace'
Explanation:- kyunki singular countable noun se pehle article lagate hain.

questions.question: He went for the lunch (a)/at 1 pm and then (b)/returned.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Remove 'the' before 'lunch'.
Explanation:- kyunki meal ke name se pehle article use nahi karte.

questions.question: Athens was (a)/ a most luminous (b)/ of all the city-states (c)/ of ancient Greece.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'the most' instead of 'a most'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan Athens ka Greece ki baaki ancient cities ke sath comparison karna hai, isliye superlative degree ('the most') lagegi.

questions.question: When the principal entered the classroom (a)/all boys shook (b)/in their shoes.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'all the boys' in place of 'all boys'.
Explanation:- Yahan uss particular class ke ladkon ki baat ho rahi hai isliye 'all the boys' aayega.

questions.question: Sunil refused to (a)/ attend the meeting (b)/ of association on Saturday. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'the' before 'association'
Explanation:- kyunki singular countable noun se pehle article lagate hain aur yahan ek particular association ki baat ho rhi hai isliye 'the association' aayega.

questions.question: The stadium was full (a)/ of spectators (b)/ from one end to other. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'the other' in place of 'other'
Explanation:- Yahan meaning dena hai 'ek end se dusre end tak' toh dusra end specific hai isliye 'the other' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Ronaldo is (a)/ a famous (b)/ player of (c)/ the football.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) Remove 'the' before 'football'
Explanation:- sports/games ke names ke sath article nahi lagate.

questions.question: An ancient (a)/considered that (b)/knowledge had its limits.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'The ancient' in place of 'An ancient'.
Explanation:- the + adjective = common plural noun ('The ancient' = ancient people / purvaz).

questions.question: There was an interesting article (a)/ in the newspaper (b)/ about the dangers (c)/to an environment.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'the environment' instead of 'an environment'
Explanation:- kyunki environment, atmosphere, sky, etc. ek hi hain isliye unke pehle 'the' article ka use hota hai.

questions.question: The scientist was awarded (a) / with an honorary doctorate for (b) / his groundbreaking research in (c) / field of molecular biology. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) Use 'the field' instead of 'field'
Explanation:- Yahan 'noun of noun' ('the field of molecular biology') ka structure ban raha hai isliye 'the' article ka use hoga.

questions.question: The sea has become (a)/ an cheap dumping ground (b)/ for all kinds (c)/ of waste products.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'a' instead of 'an' before 'cheap'
Explanation:- kyunki article 'a' ka use consonant sounding words ('cheap') se pehle kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: The accelerating pace of life in our metropolitan city (a)/ has had the tremendous effect (b)/ on the culture and life-style of the people. (c) no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'a tremendous effect' in place of 'the tremendous effect'.
Explanation:- Yahan tremendous effect ka zikr first time kiya gya hai aur meaning 'ek tremendous effect' aa rha hai.

questions.question: Four of earliest civilisations (a)/ of the world (b)/ were located (c)/ on the banks of or near large rivers.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'the' before 'earliest'
Explanation:- kyunki superlative degree ('earliest') se pehle definite article 'the' ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: Do you mind (a)/ lending me (b)/ your book (c)/ for a hour?(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'an' instead of 'a'
Explanation:- 'hour' vowel sound se shuru hota hai isliye 'an hour' aayega.

questions.question: He has taught (a)/ me how to play (b)/ flute (c)/ without taking much time.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'the flute' in place of 'flute'.
Explanation:- musical instruments ke name se pehle 'the' article ka use karte hain.

questions.question: The captain (a)/ scored a century (b)/ in a (c)/ second innings.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'the' instead of 'a'
Explanation:- kyunki 'second' ek ordinal hai isliye 'the second innings' ka use hoga.

questions.question: He is not that (a)/kind of a person who (b)/ will go back on his words. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'kind of person' in place of 'kind of a person'
Explanation:- 'kind/type/sort + of + noun' is structure mein noun se pehle article ka use nahi karte.

questions.question: Whole country (a)/ applauded the (b)/ courage of (c)/our soldiers.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'The' before 'whole'
Explanation:- 'whole' adjective se pehle 'the' article ('The whole country') ka use hota hai.

questions.question: Children enjoy listening to (a)/ ghost stories (b)/ especially on Halloween night.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'the Halloween night' in place of 'Halloween night'.
Explanation:- Specific night ki baat ho rahi hai jaise 'on the Diwali night, on the Christmas night, on the Halloween night'.

questions.question: When I met Akbar Padamsee, (a)/ one of a pioneers of Indian art, (b)/ he was 87 (c)/ but still alert and active.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'the' instead of 'a'
Explanation:- 'pioneers' plural aur specific noun hai ('one of the pioneers of Indian art'), isliye 'the' ka use karenge.

questions.question: On my request, (a)/ Navendera introduced me (b)/ to his girl friend (c)/ who is a singer and a dancer.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) Use 'a singer and dancer' in place of 'a singer and a dancer'.
Explanation:- Ek hi person ko refer karne ke liye jab 2 nouns likhe jayen toh article sirf pehle wale ke sath lagate hain.

questions.question: Most of voters (a)/ in Taiwan seem to have (b)/ once again voted for (c)/ the democratic party and President Tsai Ing-wen.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'Most of the voters' in place of 'Most of voters'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'voters' specific hain ('Taiwan ke voters') isliye definite article 'the' ka use krenge.

questions.question: Gold (a)/ of South Africa (b)/ is exported to many countries.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'The gold' in place of 'Gold'.
Explanation:- Yahan specific gold ('The gold of South Africa') ki baat ho rahi hai.

questions.question: I think Virat Kohli will remain (a)/ the captain (b)/ of the Indian team (c)/ in a year 2020.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'the' instead of 'a' (or 'in 2020')
Explanation:- 'in the year 2020' ya 'in 2020' sahi structure hai kyunki year 2020 definite hai.

questions.question: The honesty (a)/ is one of the most essential qualities (b)/ for anyone to get respect in society.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Remove 'The' before 'honesty'.
Explanation:- kyunki 'honesty' ek abstract noun hai jo yahan generalised sense mein use ho rha hai.

questions.question: We were busy (a)/ at the work (b)/ and went for lunch (c)/ only at 3:00 pm.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Remove 'the'
Explanation:- kyunki 'at work' ek fixed phrase hai.

questions.question: Kalidasa lived long before (a)/Shakespeare so Shakespeare should (b)/have been known as Kalidasa of England.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'the Kalidasa of England' in place of 'Kalidasa of England'
Explanation:- Kyunki yahan 'Kalidasa' ko common noun ki tarah use kiya gya hai aur 'of England' ki wajah se wo specific ho gya hai.

questions.question: The Prime Minister is holding the (a)/ important meeting to review the security and safety of the doctors (b)/ working in (c)/ government hospitals.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'an important meeting' instead of 'the important meeting'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan meeting ki baat first time ki gayi hai aur meaning 'ek important meeting' nikal raha hai.

questions.question: He said (a)/that he did not feel (b)/any need to discuss (c)/the episode in the detail.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) Use 'in detail' in place of 'in the detail'
Explanation:- kyunki 'in detail' ek fixed phrase hai.

questions.question: Does an (a)/English examination (b)/ begin at (c)/ 10 o'clock?(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'the English examination' instead of 'an English examination'
Explanation:- kyunki puchhne wala kisi particular examination ka time puchh rha hai.

questions.question: He boasts of (a)/having good knowledge (b)/of mathematics but everybody (c)/knows how far he is good at mathematics.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'a good knowledge' in place of 'good knowledge'
Explanation:- 'having a good knowledge of' fixed idiomatic usage hai.

questions.question: To write (a)/ a poem I need (b)/ a pen, a diary (c)/ and also the quiet place.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'a quiet place' instead of 'the quiet place'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan general 'ek quiet place' ki baat hui hai.

questions.question: When the house was (a)/set on the fire, all the people (b)/started crying at the top (c)/of their voices.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'set on fire' in place of 'set on the fire'.
Explanation:- 'set on fire' (aag laga dena) fixed phrase hai, isme article nahi lagta.

questions.question: Due to a last minute snag, (a)/ the mission (b)/ on a moon (c)/ had to be cancelled.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'the' instead of 'a'
Explanation:- kyunki celestial body ('the moon') se pehle 'the' article ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: I don't like (a)/that type of a man (b)/who does nothing but (c)/find out faults with others.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'type of man' in place of 'type of a man'.
Explanation:- 'kind/type/sort + of + noun' is structure mein noun se pehle article ka use nahi karte.

questions.question: With this (a)/ heat wave going on, (b)/ we are experiencing (c)/ a terrible weather.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) Remove 'a'
Explanation:- kyunki 'weather' ek uncountable noun hai, aur uncountable noun ke pehle 'a/an' ka use nahi kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: In 2016 after some unseemly back-and-forth (a)/ to the commons and Lords, (b)/ it was decided (c)/ that Acts of Parliament should no longer be printed on calfskin.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'the' before 'Lords' (and 'between' instead of 'to')
Explanation:- Britain ki parliament ke 2 houses ko 'the Commons' and 'the Lords' kehte hain.

questions.question: Tesla designed system (a)/ for sending electricity (b)/ over the air (c)/ through a series of enormous towers.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'a' before 'system'
Explanation:- kyunki singular countable noun ('system') bina article ke use nahi kiya jaata.

questions.question: After knowing truth,(a)/ the jury took the right decision (b)/ in the case. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'knowing the truth' instead of 'knowing truth'.
Explanation:- 'Truth' ke sath definite article 'the' ('knowing the truth') ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: Aniket lives (a)/ in the small apartment (b)/ in the suburbs.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'a small apartment' instead of 'the small apartment'.
Explanation:- kyunki yahan apartment ki baat first time hui hai aur meaning 'ek small apartment' aa rha hai.

questions.question: The present-century threats to our environment, (a)/ which include interfering species, ailments, pollution and (b)/ a boiling temperature, were putting wildlife populations at peril. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) remove 'a' and replace 'were putting' with 'are putting'
Explanation:- Remove 'a' before 'boiling temperature' aur present-century ke liye 'are putting' hoga.

questions.question: Sky appears blue (a)/ as it absorbs (b)/ all colours and (c)/ reflects only blue.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'The' article before 'sky'.
Explanation:- kyunki sky, atmosphere, environment se pehle 'the' article ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: It was (a)/ by a chance (b)/ he saw a movie in a theatre.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'by chance' instead of 'by a chance'.
Explanation:- kyunki 'by chance' ek fixed phrase hai.

questions.question: You can fool some of the people all the time, (a)/ and all the people some of the time; (b)/ but you cannot fool all the people all the time. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish: Ans (d) No error.

questions.question: She was waiting (a)/ for a opportunity (b)/to start her (c)/ own business.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'an' in place of 'a'
Explanation:- kyunki 'opportunity' vowel sound se shuru hota hai isliye 'an opportunity' lagta hai.

questions.question: This will be most difficult of (a)/ the adjustments we have to make (b)/ because we have been used to (c)/ spending a lot on guests.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'the' before 'most'.
Explanation:- Superlative degree ('the most difficult') se pehle 'the' article ka use hota hai.

questions.question: Maruti likes (a)/ adventure (b)/ stories, especially (c)/ an adventures of Tarzan. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) Use 'the adventures of Tarzan' instead of 'an adventures of Tarzan'.
Explanation:- 'Adventures' plural aur specific title hai isliye 'the adventures of Tarzan' aayega.

questions.question: Anti-party activities (a)/ improved my relations (b)/with an opposition.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'the opposition' in place of 'an opposition'.
Explanation:- 'the ruling party' aur 'the opposition' specific hote hain isliye inse pehle 'the' article ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: I love (a)/ to read certain (b)/ stories from (c)/ a Mahabharata. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) Use 'the Mahabharata' in place of 'a Mahabharata'.
Explanation:- Epics aur holy books ke naam se pehle 'the' article lagta hai.

questions.question: The more he (a)/ got to know her, (b)/more he got (c)/ attracted to her.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'the more' instead of 'more'
Explanation:- Gradual increase/decrease ko dikhane wale structure mein dono clause se pehle 'the + comparative' ka use karte hain.

questions.question: The president rewarded (a)/ that soldier for (b)/ an exceptional bravery (c)/ that he showed in the war.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'the exceptional bravery' instead of 'an exceptional bravery'
Explanation:- Yahan us specific bravery ki baat ho rhi hai jo uss soldier ne war mein dikhayi thi, isliye 'the exceptional bravery' aayega.

questions.question: The student ought to (a)/ respect his (b)/ teachers and should (c)/ be obedient. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'A student' instead of 'The student'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan kisi specific student ki nahi balki har ek general student class ki baat ho rhi hai.

questions.question: The moon is Earth's only natural satellite and the nearby large celestial body.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'the' article ke sath superlative degree 'the nearest large celestial body' (option B) sahi hai.

questions.question: It was an horrible day at the office for Roy, but he didn't allow it to spoil his evening plans.
options: (a) was a horrible day at the office
(b) were a horrible day at office
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'horrible' consonant sound hai aur 'It' ke sath singular verb 'was a horrible day at the office' (option A) sahi hai.

questions.question: Identify the sentence that correctly uses the indefinite article
options: (a) Cloud seeding involves use of chemicals that target rain-bearing clouds above a catchment area such as an river, reservoir or an lake.
(b) Cloud seeding involves use of chemicals that target rain-bearing clouds above a catchment area such as a river, reservoir or a lake
(c) Cloud seeding involves use of chemicals that target rain-bearing clouds above an catchment area such as a river, reservoir or an lake.
(d) Cloud seeding involves use of chemicals that target rain-bearing clouds above an catchment area such as an river, reservoir or a lake
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'a catchment area', 'a river', and 'a lake' teeno consonant sound hain isliye 'a' article wala option B sahi hai.

questions.question: The BBC has a wonderful series on a emergence of women novelists in English literature.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'emergence of women novelists' me 'noun of noun' ka structure create ho rha hai isliye 'the' article (option C) ka use hoga.

questions.question: The apple a day keeps the doctor away.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'Apple' se pehle 'An' article ayega ('An apple a day keeps the doctor away'), isliye B option sahi hai.

questions.question: I have an invite from a friend to visit the Canada and United States next month.
options: (b) to Canada or the united states
(c) to the Canada and United States
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'Canada' se pehle 'the' nahi aayega aur 'the United States' se pehle 'the' aata hai, isliye option D sahi hai.

questions.question:
Select the grammatically correct statement from among the given options.
A. It is a nice party. I am enjoying the party.
B. It is a party. I am enjoying an party.
C. It is party. I am enjoying a party.
D. It is the party. I am enjoying an party.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- First sentence mein 'a nice party' (first time introduce) aur 2nd sentence mein same party ke liye 'the party' (option A) sahi hai.

questions.question:
Select the grammatically correct sentence.
A. The Supriya is the best girl in the class.
B. Supriya is the best girl in the class.
C. Supriya is best girl in the class.
D. The Supriya is a best girl in the class.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'Supriya' proper noun hai iss se pehle 'the' nhi ayega aur 'best' superlative degree se pehle 'the' ayega, isliye B option sahi hai.

questions.question:
Select the grammatically correct sentence.
A. It is a old uniform but a memorable thing for me.
B. It is old uniform but a memorable thing for me.
C. It is the old uniform but memorable thing for me.
D. It is an old uniform but a memorable thing for me.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'old' mein vowel sound hai isliye 'an old uniform' aur 'a memorable thing' yaani D option sahi hai.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: (a) The rider who met with an accident was not wearing an helmet, the police said.
(b) A rider who met with the accident was not wearing the helmet, an police said.
(c) The rider who met with the accident was not wearing a helmet, the police said.
(d) The rider who met with a accident was not wearing a helmet, the police said.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'The rider', 'the accident', 'a helmet', aur 'the police' wala option C grammatically bilkul sahi hai.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: (a) The decision to change the hospital saved the life of the daughter of the doctor.
(b) A decision to change a hospital saved the life of the daughter of the doctor.
(c) The decision to change a hospital saved an life of the daughter of the doctor.
(d) The decision to change an hospital saved the life of the daughter of the doctor.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Particular 'decision' aur particular 'hospital' dono se pehle 'the' article wala option A sahi hai.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: (a) An warrior was waiting for a right time to attack the lion hiding in the cave.
(b) The warrior was waiting for a right time to attack an lion hiding in the cave.
(c) The warrior was waiting for the right time to attack the lion hiding in the cave.
(d) The warrior was waiting for an right time to attack the lion hiding in a cave.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'The warrior was waiting for the right time to attack the lion hiding in the cave' (option C) sahi hai.

questions.question:
Select the grammatically correct sentence.
A. As a nation, India is a united country and shall always remain so.
B. As nation, India is a united country and shall always remain so.
C. As the nation, India is a united country and shall always remain so.
D. As a nation, India is an united country and shall always remain so.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'As a nation' aur 'a united country' ('united' consonant sound 'yu' se shuru hota hai) wala option A sahi hai.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: (a) It was the hectic day for Susan with a lot of purchase and the couple of meetings.
(b) It was a hectic day for Susan with the lot of purchase and a couple of meetings.
(c) It was a hectic day for Susan with the lot of purchase and an couple of meetings.
(d) It was a hectic day for Susan with a lot of purchases and a couple of meetings
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'a hectic day', 'a lot of purchases', and 'a couple of meetings' wala option D sahi hai.

questions.question: The gold is a very precious metal because it is used to make ornaments.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Yahan 'Gold' material noun generalized sense mein use kiya gya hai isliye iss se pehle koi article nhi ayega.

questions.question: He met European lady at the conference who works for an NGO.
options: (b) a European lady at the conference
(c) an European lady at the conference
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'European' mein consonant sound ('yu') hai isliye 'a European lady at the conference' (option B) sahi hai.

questions.question: The more they earn, more they spend on luxury items.
options: (c) the more they ought to spend
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Gradual increase/decrease ko dikhane ke liye 'the + comparative degree' ('the more they spend') option B sahi hai.

questions.question: Kalidasa is known as the Shakespeare of India.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'the Shakespeare of India' bilkul sahi hai, isliye 'No improvement' (option D) aayega.

questions.question: The practice of starving children who have diarrhoea can also worsen the situation.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Yhan particular children ki baat ho rhi hai jinko diarrhoea hai, isliye 'starving the children' (option A) sahi hai.

questions.question: Amazon is (a)/ considered the largest river (b)/ in terms of water discharge (c)/ in the world. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) put 'the' article before 'Amazon'
Explanation:- River ke naam ('The Amazon') ke sath 'the' article ka use hota hai.

questions.question: It was a most amazing (a)/ experience for us to travel through the (b)/ mountains at night. (c) No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) No error
Explanation:- Yahan 'a most amazing' ka matlab 'a very amazing' hai.

questions.question: Old silver coin having very strange (a)/ carvings was discovered (b)/ by the archaeologists (c)/ during the excavation. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) put 'An' article before 'old silver coin'
Explanation:- 'old silver coin' singular countable noun hai aur 'old' vowel sound hai, isliye 'An old silver coin' sahi hoga.

questions.question: All of us (a)/ had the dinner together and (b)/ enjoyed the evening. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'the' article before 'dinner'
Explanation:- Meal ke naam se pehle article ka use nahi hota.

questions.question: This car is (a)/ a most expensive model (b)/ of all the vehicles (c)/ launched by the company this year. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'a' with 'the'
Explanation:- 'of all the vehicles' se comparison ho raha hai, isliye superlative degree 'the most expensive model' aayega.

questions.question: When the captain (a)/ gave the final command (b)/ all soldiers marched towards (c)/ the battlefield with determination. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) put 'the' article before 'soldiers'
Explanation:- Specific soldiers ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye 'all the soldiers' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Priya decided (a)/ to donate some money (b)/ to fund the activities (c)/ of association working for animal welfare. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) put 'an/the' article before 'association'
Explanation:- 'association' singular countable noun hai aur 'working for animal welfare' se specific ho rahi hai, isliye 'the/an association' aayega.

questions.question: The bridge stretched (a)/ from one side of the river (b)/ to other (c)/ without any visible support. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) put 'the' article before 'other'
Explanation:- River ki dusri side specific hoti hai, isliye 'to the other' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The pilot announced (a)/ that there would be turbulence (b)/ due to heavy winds in (c)/ sky ahead. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) put 'the' article before 'sky'
Explanation:- 'sky' se pehle 'the' article ('in the sky ahead') aata hai.

questions.question: The students decorated the hall (a)/ beautifully to hold a function (b)/ in an honour of their headmistress (c)/ who was retiring this month. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'an honour' with 'honour'
Explanation:- 'in honour of somebody' ek fixed idiomatic expression hai.

questions.question: He prepared (a)/ the strong cup of coffee (b)/ to stay awake (c)/ while completing his project at night. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'the strong' with 'a strong'
Explanation:- General 'ek strong cup of coffee' ke sense ke liye 'a strong cup of coffee' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The heavy rainfall this year (a)/ has had the serious effect (b)/ on the production of wheat and rice (c)/ in northern states. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'the serious' with 'a serious'
Explanation:- 'has had a serious effect' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: This is (a)/a most expensive painting (b)/ ever displayed (c)/ in the National art museum. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'a most' with 'the most'
Explanation:- 'ever displayed in the museum' se superlative comparison ho raha hai, isliye 'the most expensive painting' aayega.

questions.question: The doctor will see you (a)/ after a hour (b)/ as he is currently attending (c)/ another patient in the emergency ward. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'a hour' with 'an hour'
Explanation:- 'hour' vowel sound word hai, isliye 'an hour' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: I couldn't believe that (a)/ she learned how to play piano (b)/ when she was just six years old (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) put 'the' article before 'piano'
Explanation:- Musical instruments se pehle 'the' article ('play the piano') ka use hota hai.

questions.question: The student received (a)/ a prize (b)/ for his excellent performance (c)/ in first test of the term. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) put 'the' article before 'first'
Explanation:- Ordinal adjective ('first, second, third') se pehle 'the' article ('in the first test') ka use hota hai.

questions.question: That's the (a)/ sort of a behaviour (b)/ which can ruin (c)/ our team's reputation. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'a' before 'behaviour'
Explanation:- 'type of, sort of, kind of' ke baad article ka use nahi karte.

questions.question: Whole country (a)/ mourned deeply (b)/ after hearing the tragic news (c)/ of the national hero's death. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) put 'The' article before 'Whole'
Explanation:- 'Whole' se pehle 'the' article ('The whole country') use hoga.

questions.question: People light hundreds of lamps (a)/ and decorate their homes beautifully (b)/ on Diwali night (c)/ to celebrate the victory of light over darkness. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) put 'the' article before 'Diwali night'
Explanation:- Specific festival night ke liye 'on the Diwali night' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: She was honoured as (a)/ one of a pioneers of women empowerment (b)/ during the international conference (c)/ held in New Delhi last year. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'a pioneers' with 'the pioneers'
Explanation:- 'one of the pioneers' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Mr. Kapoor, (a)/ who is a businessman and a philanthropist, (b)/ donated a large sum (c)/ to build a hospital for underprivileged people. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'a' before 'philanthropist'
Explanation:- Ek hi person ('Mr. Kapoor') ke liye do noun likhe hain, toh baad waale noun ke sath article ka use nahi hota ('a businessman and philanthropist').

questions.question: Most of citizens in Japan (a)/ prefer using public transportation (b)/ because it is more convenient and punctual (c)/ than owning a private vehicle. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) put 'the' article before 'citizens'
Explanation:- Particular Japan ke citizens ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye 'Most of the citizens' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Tea (a)/ of Darjeeling (b)/ has a unique aroma and flavour (c)/ which distinguishes it from other varieties across the globe. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) put 'The' article before 'Tea'
Explanation:- Particular Darjeeling ki tea ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye 'The tea of Darjeeling' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The company has planned (a)/ to launch its new electric vehicle (b)/ across all the major cities of India (c)/ in an year. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) replace 'an year' with 'a year'
Explanation:- 'year' ki pronunciation consonant sound ('y') se hai, isliye 'a year' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The patience (a)/ is the key to success (b)/ when dealing with (c)/ difficult and stressful situations in life. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) remove 'The' before 'patience'
Explanation:- 'Patience' abstract noun hai aur general baat ho rahi hai, isliye 'the' article ka use nahi hoga.

questions.question: She couldn't answer my call (a)/ because she was busy at the home (b)/ preparing dinner for the guests (c)/ No error. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'the' before 'home'
Explanation:- Fixed phrase 'at home' likha jata hai.

questions.question: Mahatma Gandhi (a)/ is often regarded as Lincoln of India (b)/ because of his relentless efforts (c)/ to bring justice and equality among people. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) put 'the' before 'Lincoln'
Explanation:- Proper noun ko common noun ('the Lincoln of India') ki tarah use kiya gaya hai, isliye 'the' article lagega.

questions.question: The journalist (a)/ promised to cover the entire incident (b)/ in the newspaper article (c)/ in the detail to make people aware of the issue. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) remove 'the' before 'detail'
Explanation:- Fixed phrase 'in detail' hota hai.

questions.question: I heard that an English examination (a)/ has been postponed (b)/ due to a technical issue (c)/ in the online test system. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'an English' with 'the English'
Explanation:- Specific exam ('the English examination') ki baat ho rahi hai.

questions.question: The gold is considered a symbol (a)/of wealth and prosperity in many cultures, (b)/and people often invest in it to secure their future. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) remove 'The' before 'gold'
Explanation:- 'Gold' material noun ko generalized way mein use kiya gaya hai, isliye 'the' nahi aayega.

questions.question: The writer (a)/ mentioned that he needed a candle, a notebook (b)/ and the calm place (c)/ where no one could disturb him at night. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'the calm place' with 'a calm place'
Explanation:- General 'ek shaant jagah' ke liye 'a calm place' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The villagers (a)/ were shocked when they saw (b)/ that the entire barn had been set on the fire last night.(c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) remove 'the' before 'fire'
Explanation:- Fixed phrase 'set on fire' hota hai.

questions.question: Scientists (a)/ are planning to send another rover (b)/ to collect rock samples (c)/ from moon in the coming decade. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) put 'the' article before 'moon'
Explanation:- Celestial bodies ('the moon') se pehle 'the' article ka use hota hai.

questions.question: Because of the cyclone approaching the coast, (a)/ people are experiencing (b)/ a bad weather (c)/ with strong winds and heavy rainfall. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) remove 'a' article before 'bad weather'
Explanation:- 'weather' uncountable noun hai jiske pehle 'a' article ka use nahi hota.

questions.question: The scientist (a)/ developed model (b)/ to predict future earthquakes (c)/ based on seismic wave patterns. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) put 'a' article before 'model'
Explanation:- 'model' singular countable noun hai, isliye 'developed a model' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Once the students realised truth (a)/ behind the sudden fee hike, (b)/ they protested peacefully (c)/ demanding justice from the administration. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) put 'the' before 'truth'
Explanation:- 'realised the truth' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: It was (a)/ by a chance (b)/ that she met her childhood friend (c)/ while travelling on a train to Delhi. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'a' article before 'chance'
Explanation:- 'by chance' ek fixed phrase hai.

questions.question: The teachers (a)/ are responsible for shaping (b)/ the character and values (c)/ of the young minds in every society. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) remove 'The' before 'teachers'
Explanation:- General taur pe sabhi teachers ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye 'Teachers' se pehle 'The' nahi lagega.

questions.question: During the debate (a)/ the prime minister addressed (b)/ several questions raised (c)/ by an opposition regarding foreign policies. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) replace 'an opposition' with 'the opposition'
Explanation:- 'the opposition' specific hota hai, isliye 'the' article lagega.

questions.question: She packed her bags (a)/ in the hurry (b)/ and booked the next available flight (c)/ after hearing the news of her father's accident. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'the hurry' with 'a hurry'
Explanation:- Fixed phrase 'in a hurry' hota hai.

questions.question: The less you (a)/ worry about what others think, (b)/ more peaceful (c)/ your life will eventually become. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) put 'the' article before 'more peaceful'
Explanation:- Gradual increase/decrease structure mein dono clauses mein 'the + comparative' ('the more peaceful') aata hai.

questions.question: The audience stood (a)/ and clapped for several minutes (b)/ to appreciate an outstanding bravery (c)/ shown by the young boy who saved his friend from drowning. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'an outstanding' with 'the outstanding'
Explanation:- Yahan bravery specific hai jo uss ladke ne dikhai, isliye 'the outstanding bravery' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The manager believes that (a)/ the employee must (b)/ follow the company's rules (c)/ and work with full dedication to succeed. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'the employee' with 'an employee'
Explanation:- General har ek employee ke liye 'an employee' ka use hoga.

questions.question: It was an unforgettable evening at the concert that left everyone amazed.
options: (a) was a unforgettable evening at the concert
(b) were an unforgettable evening at concert
(c) was the unforgettable evening at concert
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) No substitution
Explanation:- 'It was an unforgettable evening at the concert' bilkul sahi hai.

questions.question: Identify the sentence that correctly uses the indefinite article.
options: (a) The scientist proposed experiment in an unique environment such as a cave or an underground lab.
(b) The scientist proposed an experiment in a unique environment such as a cave or an underground lab.
(c) The scientist proposed a experiment in an unique environment such as a cave or an underground lab.
(d) The scientist proposed an experiment in a unique environment such as an cave or an underground lab.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'an experiment', 'a unique environment', 'a cave', and 'an underground lab' wala option B bilkul sahi hai.

questions.question: The travel agency offers exciting packages to the Brazil and the United Arab Emirates for both leisure and business travelers.
options: (b) Brazil and the United Arab Emirates
(c) The Brazil and United Arab Emirates
(d) Brazil and the United Arab Emirates
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'Brazil' se pehle 'the' nahi ayega aur 'the United Arab Emirates' se pehle 'the' ayega (option B).

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct statement from among the given options.
options: (a) It is a beautiful movie. I can watch the movie again with my friends.
(b) It is the beautiful movie. I can watch a movie again with my friends.
(c) It is an beautiful movie. I can watch the movie again with my friends.
(d) It is a beautiful movie. I can watch an movie again with my friends.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- First sentence mein 'a beautiful movie' aur second sentence mein same movie ke liye 'the movie' (option A) sahi hai.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: (a) The effort to clean the park helped the community to restore a beauty of its surroundings.
(b) A effort to clean the park helped the community to restore the beauty of its surroundings.
(c) The effort to clean the park helped the community to restore the beauty of its surroundings.
(d) The effort to clean an park helped the community to restore the beauty of the surroundings.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'The effort to clean the park helped the community to restore the beauty of its surroundings' (option C) sahi hai.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: (a) As a European country, France plays a major role in promoting global peace and cooperation.
(b) As an European country, France plays a major role in promoting global peace and cooperation.
(c) As the European country, France plays a major role in promoting global peace and cooperation.
(d) As European country, France plays a major role in promoting global peace and cooperation.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'As a European country' ('European' consonant sound 'yu' hai) wala option A sahi hai.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: (a) It was the tiring day for Rahul with the lot of tasks and the couple of phone calls.
(b) It was a tiring day for Rahul with a lot of tasks and a couple of phone calls.
(c) It was a tiring day for Rahul with a lot of task and an couple of phone calls.
(d) It was the tiring day for Rahul with a lot of tasks and the couple of phone calls.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'a tiring day', 'a lot of tasks', and 'a couple of phone calls' wala option B sahi hai.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: (a) A wolf cannot protect another wolf against a stronger rival in the wild.
(b) Wolf cannot protect wolf against stronger rival in the wild.
(c) The wolf cannot protect a wolf against stronger rival in the wild.
(d) A wolf cannot protect a wolf against a stronger rival in wild.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'A wolf cannot protect another wolf against a stronger rival in the wild' (option A) sahi hai.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: (a) The harder he works, more he succeeds in achieving his dreams.
(b) The harder he works, the more he succeeds in achieving his dreams.
(c) The hard he works, the more he succeeds in achieving his dreams.
(d) The hard he works, more he succeeds in achieving his dreams.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Gradual increase/decrease structure 'The harder he works, the more he succeeds' (option B) sahi hai.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options: (a) Rabindranath Tagore is known as the Shakespeare of Bengal for his literary brilliance.
(b) Rabindranath Tagore is known as Shakespeare of Bengal for his literary brilliance.
(c) Rabindranath Tagore is known as a Shakespeare of Bengal for his literary brilliance.
(d) Rabindranath Tagore is known as like Shakespeare of Bengal for his literary brilliance.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'the Shakespeare of Bengal' wala option A sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The practice of feeding poors during festive seasons is a noble act appreciated by everyone.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'of' preposition ke baad gerund 'feeding' aur saare gareeb logon ke liye 'the poor' yaani 'feeding the poor' (option C) sahi hai.

questions.question: The practice of starving children who have diarrhoea can also worsen the situation.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Specific children (who have diarrhoea) ke liye 'starving the children' (option A) sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Your eldest sister / lives in / a big city, / does she?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'doesn't she' in place of 'does she'.
Explanation:- Yahan sentence positive hai toh question tag negative banega.

questions.question: There will probably be a lot of fish in their nets, will there?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'won't there' in place of 'will there'.
Explanation:- Yahan sentence positive hai toh question tag negative banega. Isilye will there ki jagah won't there hoga.

questions.question: I am suitably dressed for the occasion, am I?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'aren't I' instead of 'am I'.
Explanation:- Yahan sentence positive hai toh question tag negative banega. Isilye am I ki jagah aren't I hoga.

questions.question: You have locked the gate, isn't it?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) Use 'haven't you' instead of 'isn't it'.
Explanation:- 'you' ke liye 'you' pronoun aayega jiske liye plural verb aayegi, sentence positive hai toh question tag negative hoga, isliye 'haven't you' option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: The medicines have arrived, isn't it?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'haven't they' instead of 'isn't it'.
Explanation:- 'medicines' ke liye 'they' pronoun aayega jiske liye plural verb aayegi, sentence positive hai toh question tag negative hoga, isliye 'haven't they' option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: She will have to go to another school when she moves from here, has she?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'won't she' instead of 'has she'.
Explanation:- Sentence mein do clauses hai 'She will.....school' tak main clause hai aur 'she moves......here' tak sub clause, question tag humesha 'main clause' ke according banta hai, 'will' ka negative 'won't' hoga, isliye 'won't she' sahi hoga.

questions.question: She is not ready for marriage, isn't it?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'is she' instead of 'isn't it'.
Explanation:- 'she' ke liye 'she' pronoun aayega jiske liye singular verb aayegi, sentence negative hai toh question tag positive hoga, isliye 'is she' option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: You will participate in the marathon, won't you?
questions.solutionHinglish: Ans (c) No improvement

questions.question: The tree was uprooted by the storm last evening, isn't it?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'wasn't it' in place of 'isn't it'.
Explanation:- 'tree' ke liye 'it' pronoun aayega jiske liye singular verb aayegi, sentence past indefinite tense mein aur positive hai toh question tag negative hoga, isliye 'wasn't it' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: You have my mobile number, isn't it?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'don't you' instead of 'isn't it'.
Explanation:- 'has/have' agar helping verb hoti hai toh negative question tag 'hasn't/haven't' se banta hai, lekin 'has/have' agar main verb ki tarah kaam kare possession banane ke liye toh iska negative question tag 'don't/doesn't' se banega, sentence mein 'have' main verb hai jo possession bana rahi hai, isliye iska question tag 'don't you' option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: We can't live without water, will we?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'can we' in place of 'will we'.
Explanation:- Yahan sentence negative hai toh question tag positive banega. Aur jo modal verb question mein di gyi hai usi se question tag banega isilye 'will we' ki jagah 'can we' hoga.

questions.question: I imagine you have learnt a valuable lesson from this experience, didn't you?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'haven't you' in place of 'didn't you'.
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'I imagine' main clause hai aur 'you have.....experience' tak sub clause, agar 'I believe, I know, I imagine' aise main clause ho toh sub clause ke according question tag banta hai, isliye 'haven't you' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Neither of the workers was happy with the new legislation, ________?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'neither' subject ke according 'they' pronoun aayega aur 'neither' se sentence negative ho gaya isliye question tag positive banega, 'they' ke according plural verb aayegi, isliye 'were they' option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: Everybody should visit Agra, ________?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'everybody, each, either, neither, nobody, anybody, anyone, somebody, all etc.' subject ke liye question tag mein 'they' pronoun aayega, sentence positive hai toh question tag negative hoga, isliye 'shouldn't they' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: All of them have decided, ________?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'everybody, each, either, neither, nobody, anybody, anyone, somebody, all etc.' subject ke liye question tag mein 'they' pronoun aayega, sentence positive hai toh question tag negative hoga, isliye 'haven't they' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: Anyone will answer this question, ________?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'anyone' ke liye 'they' pronoun aayega aur 'will' ka negative 'won't' hoga, isliye 'won't they' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: None of us thought of doing it, ________?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'none, nobody, anybody, each, either etc.' ke sath 'of' lagake 'first, second' person ki baat karoge, toh 'first, second' person ke according pronoun aayega, question tag mein subjective case likha jata hai, isliye yaha 'us' ka subjective case 'we' hoga, 'thought' se pata chal raha past indefinite mein likha hai jiska question tag 'did' se banta hai, isliye 'did we' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Nobody in the family believes Rakesh has paid the heating bill, ________? So, he needs some time to prove himself to be reliable.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Question tag generally main clause ke according banaya jata hai isiliye yaha nobody wale clause ke according 'do they' banega. Aapko class mein padhaya gya hai ki agar main clause mein 'I believe, I know, I imagine' ho toh sub clause ke according question tag banta hai, ye kewal tabhi hota hai jab subject 'I' ho, iss question mein subject 'nobody' hai.

questions.question: He ________ hard for the exam, didn't he?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'didn't he' question tag ke according verb aayegi, question tag negative hai toh sentence positive hoga, aur 'didn't' se pata chal raha ki verb past indefinite mein aayegi, isliye option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: The jury has taken its decision, ________?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'the jury' collective noun hai jab tak collective noun mein hint naa ho alag alag hone ka toh isse singular maante hai jiske liye 'it' pronoun ka use karte hai, sentence mein 'jury' singular hai, isliye question tag 'hasn't it' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Let's go out for a walk, ________?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'Let's' suggestion dene ke kaam aata hai iska question tag 'shall we' se banta hai, isliye option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: There are many boys in the ground, ________?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'there' yahan introductory subject hai aur iska pronoun there hi hota hai, sentence positive hai toh question tag negative banega isliye option C sahi hoga.
